name: cOMApilot
author: Deunnis
description: An AI assistant that streams answers and, with your explicit confirmation, can act: open files, run a small set of safe named actions, or drive other Omarchy plugins.

barWidget.description: Click to open the AI copilot overlay.

schema.label: Endpoint URL
schema.description: Chat-completions endpoint. Change this to point at OpenRouter, a local server, etc. Ignored for the Anthropic backend.

schema.label: Include clipboard as context
schema.description: Sends your current clipboard text along with each prompt, clearly labeled as untrusted data.

schema.label: Include active window as context
schema.description: Sends the focused window's title and app id along with each prompt.

schema.label: Allow the assistant to propose actions
schema.description: Every proposed action still requires your explicit confirmation before it runs.
